answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the network creates a safe haven via game-theoretic multi-agent auditing, stake slashing, and topological cut verifications. When suspicious agent clusters form a knoll of fake identities, random auditors inspect graph bottlenecks. If a sparse cut confirms coordinated collusion, correlated stake slashing penalizes all colluding identities. Reaching the summit of voting power requires a superlinear attacker cost.
